summary: ReNew Energy Global plc furnished a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its fifth Annual General Meeting held September 16, 2026 in London. Shareholders passed all ordinary resolutions: approval of the FY2026 annual reports and accounts, approval of the directors' remuneration report, reappointment of KNAV Limited as auditor until the next AGM, and authorization for the Board and Audit Committee to set auditor remuneration. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, or advisor is disclosed. The filing is a routine AGM results notice; no deal terms, board recommendation on a transaction, or risk-arb angle apply.
